questions.question: When King Sennacherib of Assyria attacked Judah, how many of its fortified cities did he capture?
The king of Assyria's messenger, the Rabshakeh, mocked King Hezekiah for trusting Egypt. What did he call Egypt?

answers.text: A splintered reed of a staff
A crumbling wall with no gate
A dry well with no water

questions.question: The king of Assyria's messenger, the Rabshakeh, claimed the LORD Himself told him to go up against Judah and destroy it. True or false?
When the Rabshakeh called out loudly to the people of Jerusalem on the wall, how did they respond?
